Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL · JUNCTA · POLICE FORCE. (DETECTIVE BRANCH.)）

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 567
Dat 13-9-16
September 11th 1912.

Sir,
Chang Sz Yung 張士衡 a high official from Peking arrived here on the 9th instant to investigate the case of the three Manchu Royalist prisoners still in custody at the Arsenal. It is reported that he identified one of the prisoners Ar Nauh Poo 阿南諾布 as being a Manchu who held the rank of General during the Boxer outbreak. Chang visited Woosung on the 10th inst along with General Yang. He proposes to personally open the trial of the above three prisoners to-day.
Three of Chang Hsun's soldiers were arrested at the Shanghai Nanking Railway Station on the 9th inst for travelling without tickets. On being searched it was found that they were carrying letters from Chang Hsun to General Lu at Woosung. They were sent to the City Police Headquarters for examination.
Han Whe 韓恢 the labour leader, on the 10th inst sent two men to the Painters Guild in the City with a message that for a suitable sum of money he was prepared to effect a settlement of the painters strike which is still going on.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：Kpg）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

（手写批注：... mcl Sep 11.）

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局 · 联合 · 警务处。（侦探股））

刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 567 号
日期 13-9-16
1912年9月11日。

先生，
来自北京的高级官员张士衡（Chang Sz Yung）于本月9日抵达此处，以调查仍羁押在兵工厂的三名满清保皇党囚犯一案。据报，他指认其中一名囚犯阿南诺布（Ar Nauh Poo）为一名满族人，曾在义和团运动期间担任将军职衔。张氏于本月10日偕同杨将军前往吴淞。他拟于今日亲自开庭审理上述三名囚犯。
张勋的三名士兵于本月9日在上海南京火车站因无票乘车被捕。经搜查，发现他们携带有张勋致吴淞卢将军的信件。他们已被送往市警察总局接受审讯。
劳工领袖韩恢（Han Whe）于本月10日派遣两人前往市内画家公会传话，称若支付适当金额，他准备调解目前仍在持续的画家罢工事件。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

（批：Kpg）
警司。

（手写批注：... mcl 9月11日。）
